keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «사람들은 그 집에 유령이 나온다고 말한다(처음 생각)» 와 «그 집은 사실 나의 깜짝 생일 파티였다(반전)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the first thought (people say the house is haunted) and the twist (it was my secret birthday party). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Me, my friends, and my family

boxes.qen: What do people think at first?
boxes.a: People say the old house is haunted.

boxes.qen: What is the surprise at the end?
boxes.a: It is my secret birthday party with my family.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: There is an old house at the end of our street.
a road with houses on it
having ghosts in it, people say
with no one helping or pushing
The haunted house was my secret birthday party!
kept hidden so others do not know

opts: It is my secret birthday party.
evs: The haunted house was my secret birthday party!
Creak! The door opens by itself.
why: «The haunted house was my secret birthday party!» 나를 위한 깜짝 생일 파티라서 모두 «SURPRISE!» 하고 외쳐요.
It was my secret birthday party, so everyone shouts "SURPRISE!"

qs.q: "The haunted house was my secret birthday party!" What does "secret" mean here?
qs.qko: «my secret birthday party» 에서 «secret» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: I did not know about it before
evs: There is an old house at the end of our street.
Tonight, my friends and I go inside.
why: «"SURPRISE!"» 가족이 «깜짝이야!» 하고 외쳐요. 나는 파티를 몰랐어요. 그러니 «secret» 은 «몰래 준비한, 비밀의» 라는 뜻이에요.
My family shouts "SURPRISE!" because I did not know about the party. So "secret" means kept hidden from me.

qs.q: Who makes the footsteps and whispers?
opts: My family, who is waiting with a big cake.
A ghost in the old house.
evs: Then we hear footsteps and whispers!
It is my family with a big cake.
Creak! The door opens by itself.
why: 어둠 속에서 발소리와 속삭임이 들렸는데(«Then we hear footsteps and whispers!»), 불이 켜지자 케이크를 든 우리 가족이었어요(«It is my family with a big cake.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
We hear footsteps and whispers, and then we see it is my family with a big cake. You need both sentences.

ends: We have a fun party and play games in the old house.
우리는 그 오래된 집에서 신나게 파티를 하고 게임을 한다.
Next year, I plan a surprise party for my best friend.
내년에는 내가 단짝 친구를 위해 깜짝 파티를 준비한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)
write.src: “Let’s <u>turn off the lights</u> before <u>she comes in</u>.”

img.cover: Inside an old wooden house, the lights suddenly turn on, and a girl with long black hair in a ponytail and a yellow raincoat and her two friends jump in surprise as her smiling family pops out with colorful balloons and a big birthday cake with glowing candles.

scenes.1: In a dark old house, a girl with long black hair in a ponytail and a yellow raincoat and her two friends huddle together with wide eyes as the creaky front door swings open by itself, and shadowy shapes tiptoe down the dark hallway.
scenes.2: In a bright living room full of colorful balloons, a girl with long black hair in a ponytail and a yellow raincoat laughs and covers her mouth with her hands as her mom and dad hold out a big birthday cake with glowing candles, and her two friends cheer.
